meta.title: Festivales Náuticos MX
meta.description: Festivales Náuticos Mx, an organization based in Los Cabos, Mexico, organizing nautical events such as the Desfile Náutico de Muertos and the "Mar y Christmas" holiday parade.

banner.headline: Experience the magic of the sea and Mexico’s traditions at Festivales Náuticos MX.

about.paragraph: Our festivals combine the majesty of the sea with the cultural richness of Mexico. Since 2018, we’ve welcomed thousands of national and international visitors to a celebration that honors tradition, blending nautical parades, gastronomy, music, art, and unique experiences both on land and at sea.

altares.title: Altares en el Mar 2025
altares.info: “Altares en el Mar” is an immersive festival that commemorates the Day of the Dead with a monumental nautical parade. Illuminated boats transform into floating altars, accompanied by living Catrinas, live music, themed mixology, and cultural activities on land.
altares.cta: Relive the most spectacular moments from last year’s edition.

marxmas.title: Mar & Xmas 2025
marxmas.info: “Mar & Xmas” celebrates the holiday season with a parade of decorated boats filled with lights, music, and a festive atmosphere unique to Mexico. An experience that brings together the holiday spirit and the beauty of the sea.
marxmas.cta: Discover how we celebrate Christmas on the sea.

tourism.text: Los Cabos is an unmatched destination where the desert meets the sea. Enjoy iconic beaches, world-class gastronomy, vibrant nightlife, and activities that make every visit unforgettable.

sponsorship.heading: Be a sponsor
sponsorship.info: Be part of a festival that connects brands with thousands of national and international visitors. Your brand will integrate into exclusive activations, immersive experiences, and a cultural showcase that transcends borders.

gallery.heading: Past events gallery
gallery.text: See how we’ve transformed land and sea into stages filled with tradition, culture, and excitement.
